checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: bind a deterministic workspace source hash into logged run headers (harness transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain run headers bind episode identity, policy and model manifests, but not the source tree that produced the run. harness/transcript.py:17 workspace_files and tools/replay.py:16 _hash_tree provide a relative-path -> sha256 map and a tree digest for replay evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: An opt-in workspace_root writes workspace_sha256 into the header; identical source trees match, a changed source file changes the digest, and caches/logs/reports do not add noise. Default None keeps headers and actions unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new workspace.py, additive header field; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: no database/schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Define a stable skip set for .git/caches/logs/reports, sort relative paths, test changed/ignored files, bind only when workspace_root is supplied, and re-run 230 tests and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: deterministic run snapshots and record-set diffing (lattice transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain cycle evidence is prose and ad-hoc; there is no portable snapshot of run outcomes or a deterministic added/removed/changed diff. lattice/diff.py:40 diff_records matches records by (type,id), ignores volatile fields and sorts output.
impact_assessment.benefits: Capture task/seed run records (steps, reward, success, action hash, syn/phi), export/read JSONL atomically, and diff two snapshots with sorted added/removed/changed and a summary. Same battery diffs empty; a changed/removed/added run is named.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new snapshot.py and CLI; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: atomic snapshot write; state: local JSONL only, not committed.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Key by (record_type,id), ignore volatile timestamps, sort every list, test roundtrip, same-battery empty diff and edit/remove/add; run the 235-test and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: content-vs-graph snapshot digests and meta verification (research-engine transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Snapshots have no exact vs semantic digest, so a re-capture with a new timestamp is indistinguishable from a real evidence change. research-engine/engine/bundle.py:186-222 separates graph_sha256 (every record) from content_sha256 (semantic projection) and verifies an export against its meta.
impact_assessment.benefits: graph_sha256 changes on volatile capture fields; content_sha256 stays stable; a changed steps/action/syn field changes both; a .meta sidecar verifies record count, graph and content with named findings. Default export/read stays compatible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot.py adds captured_at, digest and meta helpers; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: atomic meta write; state: local sidecar only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add captured_at to VOLATILE_FIELDS, sort records deterministically, keep content projection recursive, test re-capture vs real change, meta tamper/missing, and run 241 tests plus AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: Brier/log-loss/reliability calibration and SelfModel scoring (research-engine transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain's SelfModel records confidence and outcomes but never scores whether the confidence is calibrated. research-engine/engine/calibration.py:38-159 provides Brier, log loss, base rate, skill, reliability bins and small-sample warnings.
impact_assessment.benefits: A pure calibration.summary over forecasts returns counts/coverage/Brier/log loss/skill/bins/warnings; SelfModel.calibration() scores the recorded confidence/outcome pairs; perfect/inverted fixtures discriminate; behavior is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new calibration.py and SelfModel.calibration; dependency: stdlib math only; concurrency: none; state: outcomes list additive, snapshot unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use proper scoring rules with probability clipping, validate inputs, ignore unresolved outcomes, warn below the minimum, and test perfect/calibrated/inverted/empty/coverage fixtures plus a real T3 run; full gates.
